system.description:
Known only to a handful of Gangrel Methuselahs, this power silently rebuilds your body into a supremely efficient construct, honing speed, durability and strength to truly impressive levels and leaving no outward sign at all.

Activation requires three Blood Traits, plus one more each turn past the first to maintain it. You gain an extra action every turn (a further Blood Trait buys one more, to a maximum of two bonus actions). All incoming lethal and aggravated damage is halved (round up); a single such health level before halving may be ignored entirely on a won Simple Test, and the first two health levels of any bashing attack are ignored automatically. All your attacks inflict one additional health level of damage, of whatever type. It may be used in conjunction with every other Protean power and with Celerity, Fortitude and Potence.
system.bloodCost: Three Blood Traits to activate, one per turn to maintain (plus more for extra actions)
